headlines.description: — Deni Avdija scored 31 points and hit five of Portland's 19 3-pointers to lead the Trail Blazers to a 128-111 win over the Philadelphia 76ers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deni Avdija hits 5 3s and scores 31 points as Trail Blazers hand 76ers only their 4th loss, 128-111
